reason: The README describes a plugin for importing VS Code .vsix themes, mapping their workbench colors to the DSH interface, persisting packages locally in IndexedDB, and exposing parsed theme data to agents.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DSH Web 中导入 VS Code .vsix 主题、切换主题变体，并为智能体提供主题颜色与令牌数据解析。
summaries.en: Imports VS Code .vsix themes into DSH Web, applies their available variants, and provides parsed theme color and token data to agents.

capabilities: imports and parses local .vsix theme files
stores imported packages in browser IndexedDB
applies imported color themes to the DSH interface
exposes parsed VS Code theme data through an agent tool
